title: Franklin Road Academy
subtitle: atlanta, ga March 8-11, 2027
bodyHtml:
Families, you are currently viewing a sample itinerary customized for Franklin Road Academy. Please note that this version is meant to provide a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As we get closer to departure, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates. For now, please enjoy this preview of what is planned for your student’s upcoming trip.

Day 1: Martin Luther King, Jr. National Historic Site & National Center for Civil and Human Rights

  • Travel to Atlanta!
  • Arrival in Atlanta! Meet your Tour Directors!
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Visit Martin Luther King, Jr. National Historic Site
  • Visit The National Center for Civil and Human Rights
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations with overnight security (three nights)
 

Day 2: World of Coca-Cola & Chick-fil-A College Football Hall of Fame

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the World of Coca-Cola
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Visit the Chick-fil-A College Football Hall of Fame
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Indoor Karting and Games!
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations
 

Day 3: SCAD FASH Museum of Fashion + Film & Mercedes Benz Stadium 

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit SCAD FASH Museum of Fashion + Film
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Guided Tour of the Museum of Technology and Art
  • Guided Tour of Mercedes Benz Stadium 
  • Dinner Allocation
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations

Day 4: Georgia Aquarium & Departure Home

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the Georgia Aquarium 
  • Lunch Allocation 
  • Depart for Home
introHeading: Franklin Road Academy, get ready for an unforgettable Atlanta adventure in 2027!
introText: From civil rights history to world-class attractions, this Atlanta, Georgia experience brings culture, inspiration, and excitement together in one unforgettable trip. Students will walk in the footsteps of Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. at the Martin Luther King, Jr. National Historic Site, explore the stories behind human rights at the National Center for Civil and Human Rights, and marvel at thousands of sea creatures at the Georgia Aquarium. With stops at iconic destinations like the World of Coca-Cola and the Chick-fil-A College Football Hall of Fame, this is the perfect blend of education and adventure your students will never forget!
